text:
sara: quick sync on policy gateway for canaries. we need a clear bundle contract + runtime escape hatch.
liam: two choices: central decisioning or hybrid. hybrid seems best: controller publishes signed bundles, runtimes evaluate locally with telemetry.
neha: agree. bundle must include version, grace_mode, max_stale_s, policies[], probe_specs[], signature. add "disable_remote_decisions" for private installs.
sara: propose grace_mode: allow | deny | safe-pass (default safe-pass). safe-pass = route baseline but sample candidate.
liam: probe model: controller asks runtime to run cheap probes against candidate. runtime reports {p50,p95,error_rate,requests} every 10s during canary. backoff to 1m when stable.
neha: local heuristics: if p95 > L or error_rate > E for N requests, immediate local divert. thresholds in bundle but runtime can enforce tenant-level stricter limits.
sara: decision API sketch: CheckFallback(request_id,bundle_version,variant,ctx) -> {action:[ROUTE,FALLBACK,PROBE], reason}. keep sync and fast.
ops-bot: ticket created: bundle-signing-rotation #SEC-908.
deploy-bot: published bundle v2025-03-09 to staging clusters 3m ago.
liam: add runtime diagnostics endpoint /_policy_trace?req=ID to fetch sampled decision traces (1% sampling). useful for incident debug.
neha: incident playbook: controller detects regression -> publish rollback bundle (grace_mode=deny) -> runtimes divert -> notify owners + attach sampled traces. if controller unreachable runtimes honor grace_mode or local heuristics.
sara: next steps: liam/neha proto + JSON schema for bundle; ops draft KMS rotation; i'll start RFC for policy-gateway lib (bundle manager, verifier, probe scheduler, fallback evaluator). keep runtime API tiny: gateway.check(variant,ctx) -> action.
liam: i'll mock failure modes and test stale-bundle TTL behavior.
neha: i'll run chaos test simulating controller flake in staging to validate transitions.
sara: thanks all :thumbsup: keeping this thread as canonical notes for RFC follow-up.
